# Priyesh Mishra — Product Design Consultant & UX Strategist

## About
Priyesh Mishra is a Product Design Consultant and UX Strategist based in
New Delhi, India. He leads product development for Mindbird.ai (WhatsApp
sales automation) at Scaletrix.AI. 2.5 years experience in product management,
UX design, and performance marketing across fintech, sports, and eCommerce.
B.Tech, Galgotias University.

## Expertise
- WhatsApp marketing automation and CTWA campaign strategy
- UX/UI audits for D2C and SaaS brands
- Performance marketing: Meta Ads, Google Ads, server-side tracking
- Product development: Next.js, Supabase, OpenAI, Claude API
